note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of 23.11.2026. Coverage is materially incomplete and this must be stated plainly: the web_search backend was non-functional for the whole session (searx 'Connection refused' on every query), so no open-web negative-news, regulator-action or credit-rating search could be performed. Consequently sanctions_hit, court_cases, rating, news_risk and rf_supply are all null: this means NOT VERIFIED, not 'clean'. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found, but equally no shipment, customs or B/L data was accessible, so absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence. No credit rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Brickwork) could be located. Note also the name ambiguity: the batch name 'Ventile Components Pvt Ltd' and the claimed legal name 'VENTIL COMPONENTS PRIVATE LIMITED' differ in spelling, and neither spelling produced any public trace — the entity's existence itself is unconfirmed by any source reached. Per project rules, sanctions/court/criminal matters are never rejection grounds and none are asserted here; this record should be re-run once web search is restored and the exact registered name/CIN is confirmed.
